university.name: University of Birmingham
university.summary: Public research university with its main campus at Edgbaston, Birmingham, and a second campus in Dubai. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate taught and research degrees, and international foundation pathways delivered with Kaplan through Birmingham International Academy. Pakistani applicants are covered by a dedicated country entry requirements page.
university.eligibility_note: Licensed student sponsor: listed as University of Birmingham, Birmingham, Higher Education Institution, Student Sponsor (Track Record), Student route (gov.uk register dated 2026-10-05)

scholarships.name: Postgraduate High Fliers Scholarship for January 2027
scholarships.summary: Automatic tuition fee discount for self-funded international fee payers domiciled in one of 33 listed countries, including Pakistan, who start one of 12 named full-time taught Masters programmes at the Edgbaston campus in January 2027.
scholarships.criteria_text: International fee payer, self-funded, domiciled in a listed country (Pakistan included, UK excluded), January 2027 start on an eligible full-time taught Masters at Edgbaston; unconditional offer accepted by 7 December 2026.
scholarships.deadline_note: Unconditional offer must be accepted by 23:59 UK time on 7 December 2026 (all offer conditions met and deposit paid).
scholarships.notes: Eligible programmes: Advanced Engineering Management MSc, Advanced Computer Science MSc, Computer Science MSc, Digital Media and Communications MA, Digital Media and Creative Industries MA, Education MA, Financial Management MSc, Human Resource Management MSc, International Business MSc, Marketing MSc, MPA, Public Management MSc. Page does not state whether the discount is one-off or per year; one_off recorded for one-year Masters. Not available to students with external tuition sponsorship. Cannot be combined with full-fee scholarships.

scholarships.name: Birmingham Business School Masters Scholarship
scholarships.summary: Competitive Business School awards in three categories (academic excellence, responsible business, outstanding talent) for offer holders on 18 named full-time MSc programmes starting September 2027. Applicants domiciled in China or India are directed to other schemes.
scholarships.criteria_text: Offer holder for an eligible full-time MSc at Edgbaston, September 2027 start, domiciled outside China and India (Pakistan and United Kingdom are on the listed domiciles); personal statement and responsible business essay.
scholarships.deadline_note: Application link is sent after the offer letter; assessed on a rolling basis; closes 1 March 2027.
scholarships.notes: Page gives only a maximum (up to GBP 25,000); individual award amounts, number of awards, payment form (fee discount or cash) and basis are not stated, so fixed_amount and one_off are placeholders for the cap. Eligible MSc programmes include AI in Management, Accounting and Finance, Business Analytics, Economics, Financial Management, Financial Technology, Human Resource Management, International Business, Investments, Management, Marketing, Money Banking and Finance, Supply Chain Management and others (18 in total). Eligible domicile list covers many countries; only PK and GB recorded here.

scholarships.name: BIA Progression Award for Academic Excellence
scholarships.value_text: GBP 5,000 discount on first year undergraduate tuition
scholarships.summary: Competitive tuition discount for overseas fee paying students who complete a Birmingham International Academy Foundation Pathway in 2026/27 and progress to the first year of a Birmingham undergraduate degree in September 2027. Applies to the first year only and is not renewable.
scholarships.criteria_text: Overseas fee payer, self-funded (no full or partial third-party sponsorship), completed a BIA Foundation Pathway in 2026/27 with a final confirmed overall BIA grade of at least 90%, progressing to year one of a Birmingham undergraduate degree in September 2027.
scholarships.deadline_note: No separate application; eligible students are considered once final BIA results are confirmed and only selected students are contacted. Page lists 31 August 2027 as the deadline.
scholarships.notes: Terms and conditions (https://www.birmingham.ac.uk/study/international/fees/scholarships/bia-progression-award-for-academic-excellence-terms-and-conditions) set no nationality or domicile restriction beyond overseas fee status; awards are limited and competitive, number not stated; may normally be held with another University partial scholarship or discount, not with third-party sponsorship. Only relevant to students already on a BIA Foundation Pathway (admissions handled by Kaplan International Pathways).

could_not_verify: International tuition fees: every birmingham.ac.uk course page opened shows only 'Fees (UK/Ireland)' figures; the international fee sits behind a 'Fees information for: select a country' selector that WebFetch cannot render. Central fee pages (study/international/fees, PG taught fees, UG tuition, PGR fees, legacy international finance page) state that fees are on course pages or in the offer letter and publish no amounts.

Second pass on 2026-10-10 (fees only): no official page stating international fees in plain text was found. Checked and found no international amounts: study/international/fees, study/undergraduate/fees-funding/tuition, study/postgraduate/taught/fees-funding/taught-fees, study/postgraduate/research/fees, study/postgraduate/course-search (no fees in listings), study/international/country/pakistan (no fees), offer holder hub what-next, publication scheme and services-we-offer pages (no fee schedule), study/international/bia and foundation-pathways-bia (no fees; points to Kaplan), and course pages for Computer Science MSc (also via legacy URL), International Business MSc, Accounting and Finance MSc and Medicine and Surgery MBChB A100 (UK/Ireland fees only). No birmingham.ac.uk PDF fee schedule surfaced in searches; search results were dominated by third-party aggregators, which were not used.

UK/Ireland fees seen (not usable as international fees, recorded only for context): Computer Science MSc GBP 12,150 (January 2027) and GBP 12,780 (September 2027); International Business MSc GBP 17,460 (January 2027) and GBP 18,360 (September 2027); Accounting and Finance MSc GBP 19,890 (September 2027); MBChB GBP 10,050 (2027/28).
